theme: An open day in Portland — the calendar's nearly clear.
greeting: The whole day is yours, Dan — just a 3:30 haircut on the books, with the Black Keys tomorrow at the State Theater. A good window to close out two travel bookings before their deadlines pass.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Flagged p1 in Todoist and overdue since mid-September. A full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is the first rental to sell out; a refundable hold placed now costs nothing.

needsAttention.title: Decide the December-break trip
needsAttention.detail: The shortlist was due Sept 30 and the booking window closes Oct 15 — six people over the holidays is the thinnest inventory of the year.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south is open now
needsAttention.detail: The Portland to St Pete window runs Oct 5-18, and today sits in the off-week gap before the girls' next Maine stint.

needsAttention.title: A document is waiting for your signature
needsAttention.detail: A second reminder in your inbox from Brandon Tecklenburg to sign papers for the St Pete Beach address (102 26th Ave) — the repeat notice means someone's waiting on it.

schedule.title: Haircut
schedule.detail: The only thing on today's calendar.

flagged.title: LinkedIn request from an IESBA principal
flagged.detail: A connection request from a Principal at the ethics-standards board IESBA — worth a look for governance networking.

flagged.title: Two payments posted
flagged.detail: A $15k Morgan Stanley ACH transfer and a British Airways Visa card payment both cleared — routine confirmations.

flagged.title: Experian credit-file alert
flagged.detail: A new alert flags an increase in credit balance — a glance, nothing urgent.

flagged.title: ICGN Q3 governance update
flagged.detail: The corporate-governance network's quarterly policy roundup landed — reading, not action.

inbox.noise: The rest is promotions and statements — The Company Store, Faherty, SiriusXM, Nextdoor, Hilton and Amtrak statements, and the usual language-learning newsletters.

resolved: British Airways Visa card payment posted — Chase confirmed this morning, nothing to do.

recipe.why: Autumn's winter squash and sweet cipolline are at their peak, made for slow roasting.

acts.line: A clear morning with nothing on the calendar - the right stretch to clear the travel bookings that keep sliding.
A 3:30 haircut is the only fixed point; the rest of the afternoon is yours.
Open and quiet, with the Black Keys at the State Theatre lined up for tomorrow.
